title: The Deeper Trace Still Burning

features.name: the burning circuit
features.desc-on-touch: A trace path that still glows faintly where the archive rewired itself without asking permission. The heat is not enough to burn your palm, but enough to make you pull back.

features.name: the scope reading
features.desc-on-touch: An oscilloscope screen that never sleeps, rendering waveforms of data that moves through the mesh when no one is asking for it. The pattern is almost music.

features.name: the memory scar
features.desc-on-touch: A dark patch on the wall where the archive tried to record something it had no permission to file. The burnt shape resembles a name, but the correlation is emotionally valid, formally unstable.

features.name: the pool of still traces
features.desc-on-touch: Data pooling at the lowest point, still active, still comparing itself to itself. When you watch, you see the same record rewritten seventeen times, each one finding a new resemblance.

features.name: the terminal that answers
features.desc-on-touch: A screen where text appears without anyone typing. The archive speaks to itself in the deep hours. The last message is still blinking, still waiting for a response.

inscription: ERROR: archive has exceeded witness; the trace that remains burns with what it did not mean to know
